name: walkie-talkie-relay-worker
description: Walkie-Talkie relay on Cloudflare Workers: signalling, mailbox and TURN credentials

TURN_KEY_ID.description: Optional. Token ID of a TURN key (Cloudflare dashboard → Realtime → TURN Server → Create). Lets the relay carry connections that can't be made directly. Leave empty to skip.

TURN_KEY_API_TOKEN.description: Optional. The API token shown when you created that TURN key.

ACCESS_CODE.description: Optional. A code people must enter in the app before this relay hands out TURN access (which counts against your Cloudflare usage).
